Id.description: Opaque resource identifier. Do not parse business meaning or assume source database PK type.

RowVersion.description: Optimistic version from the last read of the mutated resource; stale write returns 409.

title.description: Read-only canonical project display name; edit through update_project

row_version.description: Current Spec.row_version, not the workspace version. Omission is accepted only for a locked pristine initial Spec; other source submissions require its current version.

SpecSubmit.description: Exactly one of source_asset_id or source_text is required. Existing initial record may be corrected, not versioned as a specs revision product.

casting_id.description: Create/extract null allocates generated casting ID; update null preserves current ID. Non-null changes must be unique. Candidate UUID remains identity.

upload_url.description: A scoped transfer URL for an open session. Closed sessions return null and empty upload_headers.

upload_metadata.description: Exact server-reserved TUS metadata. Never accept a caller-selected destination.

processing_issues.description: Safe persisted technical outcomes; originals and useful material remain available. Raw provider errors stay private.

grant_token.description: Secret issued to active renderer only; store only verifier server-side and embed in private PDF. Never place raw token in jobs, outbox, manifest, logs or callback.

token.description: Returned once. Treat as a bearer secret; never log it.

access_token.description: Scoped ephemeral review access; no internal/library permissions.

status.description: Recorded durable job status for this acknowledgement. Reusing an existing job reports its current status; an idempotent replay may retain its original acknowledgement. Read poll_url for current status.

output_key.description: Stable logical output name within this job attempt. Retries with the same key and metadata reuse the same immutable reservation; conflicting metadata is rejected.

access.description: Lease-scoped exact-object access. Write is only a newly reserved immutable output, never an original.

ServiceAssetAccess.description: Private service-only transfer capability. Headers are credentials and must not enter URLs, ordinary job metadata, logs or n8n envelopes. Exact object, method and lifetime are lease-bound; no arbitrary destination/signing interface exists.

JobOutputReservationResult.description: Actual immutable derivative reservation plus a lease-bound transfer capability. This is a direct new-object POST, not a signed-upload PUT or an upsert grant.

result.description: Validated by the allowlisted job/stage result schema. prepare_document uses contracts/json-schema/document-preparation.schema.json; source_asset_id is null only for direct pasted text, while real files require their verified asset ID.

CandidateSupport.description: Explicit supporting attachment, separate from extracted frames and reusable facts.
